submitted_prompt:
Make a simplified pixel art walking motion sprite sheet of the character in Image 1, actual transparent background, arrange eight chronological frames in 4 columns by 2 rows.

Image 1 is the sole identity, equipment, pixel style and camera reference. Keep his grounded adult proportions, bone mask, dark hair/topknot, charcoal-blue cloth around the neck and shoulders, ochre sash, leather wraps and boots, and the same broad bronze axe in his anatomical RIGHT hand (the near hand on screen-left). The opposite hand stays empty. Every frame faces LOWER-RIGHT, showing the same front-right three-quarter view. Preserve the reference's roughly 56-pixel crown-to-sole body construction and deliberate crisp square clusters, using at most 32 natural colors.

One complete in-place walk: frame0 right foot forward contact/left foot back; frame1 weight down onto right foot; frame2 right leg supporting while left foot passes it; frame3 left knee advances; frame4 left foot forward contact/right foot back; frame5 weight down onto left foot; frame6 left leg supporting while right foot passes it; frame7 right knee advances back into frame0. Show actual alternating legs and planted weight with small torso bob and a restrained natural axe carry. Keep the same camera, body size, central ground origin and feet plane in every equal cell. Leave empty margin around every full figure and axe. No labels or grid lines.
